name: daftai-cloudflare-billing-audit
description: Audits a Cloudflare application repository for code paths and configuration that may create usage-based billing exposure. Use when asked to inspect Cloudflare Worker, D1, Durable Objects, storage, queue, or compute usage for unexpected bills, billing risks, or cost drivers. Reports evidence and uncertainty. Runs offline by default; optionally correlates user-authorized, bounded evidence from existing official tools. Does not guarantee a spending cap.
